$comment: Grouped reminders in a server channel: /server command, /settings channel-reminders option, message posted by the notifications job.

settings.channel_reminders_no_channel: ⚠️ This server has no reminder channel yet: an administrator needs to run `/server reminders channel:#channel`. Until then, your reminders stay in direct messages.

server.forbidden: This command is reserved for members with the **Manage Server** permission.
server.channel_invalid: Pick a text channel of this server.
server.bot_cannot_write: I cannot write in {channel}: I need the **View Channel**, **Send Messages** and **Embed Links** permissions.
server.nothing_to_do: Provide a channel (`channel`), an interval (`every`) or `off:true`.
server.no_channel_for_interval: Configure a channel with `channel` before tuning the interval.
server.reminders_set_body: Reminders of players who opted in (`/settings channel-reminders:true`) will be grouped in {channel}. At most one message every {minutes} min, and at most {max} players mentioned per message.
server.reminders_off_body: No reminder will be posted in this server anymore. Affected players fall back to direct messages.
server.status_reminders_on:
Channel: {channel}
Interval: one message every {minutes} min
server.status_reminders_off: Disabled. `/server reminders channel:#channel` to enable them.
server.status_footer: Reserved for members with the “Manage Server” permission.
